name: ticket-state
description: Keep each docs ticket's ledger and derive, from the tracker, the forge and the files, its state, its next step and the open gate; start and finish tickets within the limits, and run the day. Watch the boards and the PRs, and start the runner on the tickets that changed (launchd). No dependencies.
